question: Can Godot rebuild its entire presentation subtree during a fixed-tick run while application-owned canonical state produces the same receipts as a reference model?

sources.title: Godot SceneTree fixed-tick ordering
sources.claim: physics_frame precedes node physics processing and deferred calls flush after node processing

distinguishing_outcomes: All four Godot AUTH_RECEIPT hashes match the reference in headless and rendered modes: retain the replaceable-presentation adapter pattern for this fixture.
Hashes diverge only after presentation rebuild: investigate feedback from presentation state into canonical state or ordering assumptions.
Headless and rendered hashes differ: identify renderer/display-dependent feedback before using Godot as a replaceable client.
The fixture cannot execute as written: repair harness/setup separately from the technical claim.
stop_condition: Obtain one complete four-receipt run in headless and rendered modes, or retain the exact execution blocker without widening the claim.
